skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop the ability to construct and evaluate arguments, identify and avoid logical fallacies, and enhance the persuasiveness of arguments.
Understand the structure of arguments, differentiate between deductive and inductive reasoning, and apply rhetorical devices to strengthen arguments.
Work effectively in groups, including task delegation, communication, and conflict resolution.
Express and defend personal viewpoints in a logical and objective manner.
Apply critical thinking to solve real-world problems.
Recognize and avoid ethical biases in arguments.
Participate in debates and defend viewpoints.
